flags.detail: test_cc_mod4_hint_reconciled_by_level_split reads pre-tabulated report fields directly from trace_norm_split.json rather than recomputing the trace/norm split itself

The claim of existence for r=8.863405356 rests on cc's own collocation instrument, whose truncation parameters were tuned upward specifically because the first choice nearly produced a false negative for that same value (documented candidly in FINDINGS.md as error (2)); the fix is well-documented but the eigenvalue's confirmation and the instrument's calibration were adjusted together in the same arc.

scale_weight_ledger/FINDINGS.md explicitly warns that its 7 new weight-0 dimensionless numbers are an unusually attractive look-elsewhere trap and forbids testing them against physical constants outside a fresh sealed preregistration -- self-aware of, but does not eliminate, the risk that a future arc will informally fit one of these to a PDG value.

s4_closing_types' original identification of the 'rank' external-input closing with the 8x1 diagram automorphism tau rested on tau being 'the only rank-reducing involution' -- a type/dimension coincidence (both look like a single F2 bit) later shown by tau_vs_singlet to be a category error: the cascade's actual rank drop 6->4 is effected by two VEVs, neither an involution.
All three tests read fields (verdict, artifact, real, p_full) directly from null_test.json, the arc's own stored result, without recomputing the underlying statistic in this file

test_kappa_meets_the_sealed_gate and test_the_two_disagreements_are_the_known_vocabulary_boundaries read kappa/n/disagreements straight from kappa.json rather than recomputing kappa from raw rating data (test_kappa_is_computed_not_asserted partially mitigates this by checking the formula, but on the same stored p_o/p_e, not raw ratings)
All four tests read S/V/C/M/killed_by fields directly from the arc's own map.json rather than recomputing the axis classification
